_: The King's hosts and their orders (hosts.js; Warcraft III's command card, Total War's campaign map: an army is one thing on the map, ordered as one). near: crown companies within this many tiles of each other (and under no separate order) are one host. speed: tiles a host moves each season on an order. men: men to a company, as the ledger counts them. splitMin: a host needs at least this many companies to split. ships: the hulls that carry a host over water, never part of one (Mac: ships only move armies, no war by sea; realmrules units.ruleset keeps these two, neither can attack). ordersPerSeason: orders the King may give his hosts in one season, all hosts together (Total War's one move a turn; gameplay review #3: three hosts were sent in one second). speed 8 (was 3: a far town was 19 seasons away in a 22-season reign; gameplay review #7). A march on a great house's town lays siege when the host reaches its walls (the decree's siege, campaigns.js): the house and the realm hear of it when the order is given (data/decrees.json march.favour, march.others). siegeAssaults: assaults the royal host makes on a besieged town, one a season once at the walls (Freeciv fights each: realmrules script.lua realm_assault), before its captains lift the siege.
